Name: Fishing Arcade
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=5][b]Fishing Arcade[/b][/size]

[i]Bring a little arcade action to your next fishing trip.[/i]
Fishing Arcade replaces Stardew Valley's fishing minigame with three playable alternatives: [b]Tetris, Breakout, and Snake[/b].
Play your favorite, or enable several and let each catch surprise you. Each game has its own difficulty settings, game modes, and fish quality options.

[size=4][b]Three Games to Play[/b][/size]

[b]Tetris[/b]
Arrange falling blocks and clear lines. Use the next-piece preview, ghost piece, and hold feature to plan your moves. Consecutive clears and an empty board award bonus points. Optional rising rows add extra pressure.

[b]Breakout[/b]
Move your paddle, bounce the ball, and destroy bricks. Watch your remaining lives and keep the ball in play. Clearing the board starts another wave.

[b]Snake[/b]
Collect food, grow longer, and navigate around obstacles. Avoid your own body and the arena walls, or choose a difficulty that allows wrapping around the edges.

[b]Game Selection[/b]
[*][i]Enable one game to play it every time.[/i][/*]
[*]Enable multiple games for a random selection with equal chances.
Disable all three to return to the original fishing minigame.

[size=4][b]Two Game Modes[/b][/size]
[b]Target Score[/b]
Reach the required score before time runs out to complete the catch immediately.
[b]Time Attack[/b]
Keep playing until the timer ends. You must survive and reach the minimum required score to complete the catch.
Both modes use a default time limit of [b]60 seconds[/b].

[size=4][b]Build Your Fish Quality[/b][/size]
Every game and mode starts at [b]Normal quality with an empty quality gauge[/b].
Scoring points raises the gauge. With time decay enabled, the gauge gradually falls between scoring opportunities, encouraging you to keep earning points.
Silver, Gold, and Iridium stars mark the quality thresholds. The gauge shows your current expected quality, which is used when you successfully complete the catch.
Each game lets you:
Enable or disable quality decay over time.[]Adjust how strongly scoring restores the gauge.
[list]
[*]Keep earned gauge progress from decaying by turning time decay off.[/*]
[/list][b]Note:[/b] A high quality gauge does not replace the catch requirements. You still need to complete the selected game mode.

[size=4][b]Choose Your Difficulty[/b][/size]
Select [b]Easy, Normal, Hard, or Custom[/b] separately for each game.
Custom settings have their own submenu, so the main settings pages stay easy to navigate.
[b]Tetris Custom Settings[/b]
[list]
[*]Falling speed[/*]
[*]Lock delay[/*]
[*]Score targets[/*]
[*]Rising rows[/*]
[*]Block size distribution[/*]
[*]Bonus scoring[/*]
[*]Screen shake intensity or disabling screen shake[/*]
[/list][b]Breakout Custom Settings[/b]
[list]
[*]Ball speed and acceleration[]Paddle size and speed[]Brick layout and durability[]Remaining lives[]Score targets[]Time limit[/*]
[/list][b]Snake Custom Settings[/b]
[list]
[*]Board size[/*]
[*]Movement speed[/*]
[*]Starting length and growth[/*]
[*]Obstacles[]Wall wrapping[/*]
[*]Food score[]Score targets[/*]
[*]Time limit[/*]
[/list][b]Fish Difficulty[/b]
Fish difficulty affects each challenge.
Breakout's Target Score presets also account for ball speed, brick durability, and slowing tackle effects when calculating the required score.

[size=4][b]Fishing Rewards and Treasure[/b][/size]
Successful catches use the game's existing fishing reward process.
Treasure objectives can appear within the arcade games. Collect them and successfully complete the catch to receive the treasure.
Fishing tackle has effects adapted to the different games.
[b]The Training Rod remains limited to Normal fish quality.[/b]

[*]Z: Rotate counterclockwise[/*]

[*]C: Hold[/*]
[/list][b]Breakout[/b]
[list]
[*]Left / Right or A / D: Move paddle[/*]
[*]Space: Launch[/*]
[/list][b]Snake[/b]
[list]

[/list][b]All Games[/b]
[list]

[/list]The timer and quality decay stop while paused or when the game loses focus.
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI 4.0.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] is optional and provides access to the settings in-game.
You can also edit [b]config.json[/b] directly.

[b]Updating[/b]
When updating, preserve your existing [b]config.json[/b] if you want to keep your settings.
Replace the previous installation instead of installing a second copy alongside it.
